description: Trim a video to a segment starting at an offset, optionally with a duration

duration_seconds.description: Optional length in seconds of the trimmed segment, starting at start_seconds; must be > 0 when given.

file_path.description: Path to the local video file to trim.

output_file.description: Path of the video file to write the trimmed segment to.

start_seconds.description: Offset in seconds from the start of the video at which the trimmed segment begins; must be >= 0.

name: trim_video
